visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women stand in a modern living room. The woman on the left wears a light blue frilly top over a white shirt; the middle woman wears a bright pink sleeveless top; the woman on the right wears a light green crop top with the word 'PEARL'. They stand on a checkered brown and tan floor in front of a white sofa and a minimalist shelving unit filled with books and plants. (2) A transition occurs to a static meme image of a man looking back at a woman in a red dress while his girlfriend looks on in shock. (3) The three women recreate the meme in their living room. The woman in blue acts as the man, looking back at the woman in the green crop top, while the woman in pink acts as the indignant girlfriend. Text 'Pose1' appears at the top. (4) The scene shifts as the three women stand in a circle, pointing fingers at one another in a serious manner, mimicking a famous pointing meme. (5) A split-screen effect shows the women in green and pink laughing and pointing on the left, while the woman in blue sits alone on the right, looking down at an empty white plate on a wooden table. Text 'Pose3' is displayed. (6) The trio poses with finger guns pointing toward the camera, wearing confident expressions. Text 'Pose4' appears above them. (7) A brief static image shows a woman intervening in a fight between two boys. (8) The women recreate the fight scene, with one woman mock-choking another while the third stands behind them with a shocked expression. (9) A final static image shows three people in awkward 90s-style denim outfits and poses. (10) The three women finish by recreating the awkward 90s poses, standing in a diagonal line and looking back over their shoulders with exaggerated smiles. Text 'Pose6' is shown.
